units.source_text: 在箱根旅馆里见面时，她已是一位不显眼的能干的妻子，我感到有点意外。

en.t: When I met her at the inn in Hakone, she had already become an unassuming but capable wife, which surprised me a little.

units.source_text: 但她抱着婴儿时那种不讲究穿戴、因操持家务而憔悴的形象，

en.t: But the sight of her holding the baby, careless about her clothes and worn down by household work,

units.source_text: 还残留着当年山村牧歌式的风采。

en.t: still retained the pastoral grace of the mountain village in those days.

units.source_text: 一见之下，就知道她是一位温顺贤惠的妻子。

en.t: At a glance, one could tell that she was a gentle and virtuous wife.

units.source_text: 她抱着的婴孩如此漂亮，我是见所未见。

en.t: The baby she held was so beautiful that I had never seen anything like him before.
He truly filled one with wonder.

units.source_text: 八个月的男婴，长得端正威风，身上好像蕴蓄着大竹七段的勃勃雄心。

en.t: The eight-month-old boy had fine, imposing features, and seemed to hold within him all the vigorous ambition of Otake, seventh dan.

units.source_text: 婴儿肌肤洁白，可爱极了。

en.t: The baby's skin was fair and pure, and he was utterly adorable.
